mechanism_fidelity.reason: The builder reads the exact inventory and schema, expands every surface epic, finding, and required asset, validates complete authored dispositions, binds current P8 evidence, and fails silent loss or authority laundering.

source_and_authorship_custody.reason: Every source path, source record, source digest, source resolution status, disposition, product relationship, authority owner, acceptance rule, and successor receipt remains independently visible and hash-bound.

interaction_semantics.reason: P9 is a machine-readable governance register and creates no new product interaction surface; the current successor interaction semantics remain controlled by the fresh P7 and P8 receipts.

motion_and_temporal_continuity.reason: P9 creates no motion surface; later disposition changes require exact source-linked amendments rather than inferred temporal promotion.

responsive_and_accessible_operation.reason: P9 is deterministic machine governance; accessible operation of the current Manzanita successor remains controlled by P8, while the other source surfaces retain their own open accessibility gates.

performance_resilience_and_failure.reason: Exact counts, schema validation, duplicate detection, missing-disposition failure, component-drift failure, private-key refusal, P8 regression refusal, and deterministic rebuilding prevent silent coverage loss.
